model.status_note: Rules were built after seeing development data; only measurements released after freeze_date count as holdout.

predictions.rule: S2: last-rendered generation is 'me' -> lower octant
predictions.kill_if: upper octant (s23^2 > 0.5) established at >= 3 sigma, or s23^2 excluded at >= 3 sigma

predictions.rule: T1 (TM1: |U_mu1| = |U_tau1|) + M1 (lepton circulation opposite to quarks)
predictions.kill_if: value excluded at >= 3 sigma, or sin(delta) > 0 established at >= 3 sigma

predictions.rule: S2 distinction channels (= TM1 to first order)
predictions.kill_if: value excluded at >= 3 sigma by a sub-percent measurement
gamma or alpha excluded at >= 3 sigma

predictions.observable: H0 from direct present-epoch readouts (ladders, time-delay lenses, standard sirens) [km/s/Mpc]
predictions.kill_if: a direct readout excluded at >= 3 sigma
r < 0.002 at 95% CL, or r > 0.006 detected

predictions.observable: ratio H0(direct present readout) / H0(early-record inference, same data release era)
decisive_experiments: any pair of direct and CMB/BAO+BBN H0 determinations

decisive_experiments: any pair of direct and CMB/BAO+BBN H0 determinations
predictions.kill_if: ratio excluded at >= 3 sigma; indistinguishable from P11 at present precision (0.06% apart)
